outcome: sensitivity and specificity of cord blood bilirubin level for predicting hyperbilirubinemia
finding: At a cut-off of 2 mg/dL, cord blood bilirubin level had a sensitivity of 76.2% and specificity of 89.9% for predicting significant neonatal hyperbilirubinemia.
mod_finding: 34% of participants underwent caesarean section, with fetal distress being the most common indication.
